title: Curonian Lagoon SFINCS model: Storm Xaver 2013 hindcast
description:
A whole-lagoon compound-flood model of the Curonian Lagoon (Lithuania), built with HydroMT-SFINCS and run on a Linux build of SFINCS v2.4.0 Galibier, together with the reproducible preparation, build and validation pipeline.

The first hindcast covers Storm Xaver, 28 November - 11 December 2013, in three forcing variants (spatially uniform wind, gridded ERA5 wind, gridded wind plus mean sea level pressure). All three are validated against four water-level gauges and meet all four success criteria defined in the model specification.

Raw source data (the 5 m DEM, the gauge database, and the SFINCS executable itself) are not redistributed here; see the repository README for what a clone must regenerate.
